summary: The prepared main checkout already contains the issue-specific correction: Qwen3.5/3.6 draft configuration writes num_nextn_predict_layers=1 to hf_text_config, where ModelConfig shape derivation reads it. This prevents the KV profiler from falling back to the target's 64 layers and inflating the EAGLE cell size from 34,816 to 163,840 bytes/token. This PR adds regression and boundary coverage; it does not duplicate the existing source fix.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-88e1cf3f5c32/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/configs/test_model_config_shapes.py::TestQwen35DraftConfig::test_conditional_generation_mtp_depth_is_visible_to_shape_derivation (after temporarily removing the existing hf_text_config assignment)
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: without the prepared source fix, the nested text config has no num_nextn_predict_layers and the issue-specific assertion fails. Raw output: reports/j-88e1cf3f5c32/pytest-failing-before.log

11 tests passed. The Qwen wrapper and causal-LM draft variants expose one MTP layer through hf_text_config, target configs remain unchanged, and FP8 KV arithmetic for 16 full-attention layers plus one MTP layer is 34,816 bytes/token rather than the reported erroneous 163,840 bytes/token. Raw output: reports/j-88e1cf3f5c32/pytest-focused.log

gpu_execution_evidence: The assigned device is an AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), recorded in reports/j-88e1cf3f5c32/gpu-inventory.log. The report requires an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell checkpoint run with unsloth/Qwen3.6-27B-NVFP4 weights, which were not available. The deterministic configuration and byte-accounting regression is CPU-only; no GPU execution is claimed.
remaining_limitations: No full-model reproduction was performed because the reported NVIDIA Blackwell architecture and Qwen3.6-27B-NVFP4 weights were unavailable.
The prepared checkout is a shallow snapshot, so the local commit history cannot identify the exact commit that introduced the already-present nested-config assignment.

Upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/30092 remains open and proposes a broader outer-config fallback; this PR only preserves evidence for the issue-specific Qwen path already fixed in the prepared source.
A separate draft embed/lm_head pre-profile memory issue is tracked in upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/32468 and was not conflated with the reported 5x cell-size defect.
